justification: Both are carved stone surfaces featuring a circular/disc motif, but that is the extent of the correspondence. Image A is a freestanding anthropomorphic monolith with a full figural composition (head, arms, belt, disc as belly ornament), while Image B is a low-relief panel showing a row of arched shapes over a band of hatched pattern and small animal-like figures, with no overall figural or bodily arrangement comparable to A.
